ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=ax+b\ (a\neq 0)$ passes through points A and B. What is the solution set of the inequality $ax+b>0$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} According to the function graph, it is known that when $x > -3$, $y > 0$, \\
therefore, the solution set of the inequality $ax+b>0$ is $x > -3$. \\
Hence, the answer is: $\boxed{x > -3}$.
